## Independence and exact integrated scope

The original independent reporter authored no engineering, test, Design or plan content. This reassessment freshly inspects all M3 corrections and their runtime integration, relying on unchanged portions of the prior complete review only after checking their continued basis. Exact governing Design four-member package and Delivery plan remain unchanged; contextual old source observations retain their historical scope. Current exact subjects are recorded above. No activity/work or engineering content was changed by this reviewer.

The complete operator path is now demonstrated through production CLI parsing, environment input/output/summary and dispatch with a real produced candidate and actual check/metadata/packed-install chain. Internal source-root/provider injection is a test seam, not a new public CLI bypass. External-only substitutions supply provider authorization, registry/release transport and injected remote failures. Actual authorization policy, retained artifact binding, public-evidence validators and local Git CAS/persistence are retained. New correction proof includes lost npm response, actual failed CLI smoke, failed Git reporting and recovered observations under the original candidate/approval. Current evidence reading checks recorded public identity/companions and returns incomplete outcomes accordingly.

The optional mirror records exact durable snapshot commit/digest; a later metadata record points back to that snapshot without circular self-hashing. Public evidence conflicts are not overwritten, missing mirror is an explicit diagnostic and does not fabricate publication failure or success. Approved source/package bytes stay immutable. No real tag, package or release was published; no remote environment or credential setup was changed.

## Validation evidence and limits

Authoritative release-m3-implementation-r2 matches exact M3 subjects at6b6db7fc. `bash scripts/ci.sh --mode explicit` with the16 behavior paths recorded in that evidence and /tmp/release-m3-selected-ci.log passed exit0: adapters.regression24.61s, adapters.drift0.21s, adapters.validate12.87s, release_transaction.regression132.70s and selector.regression62.66s. This selected run actually executed the full release-transaction regression entrypoint and selector suite; it is not a dry-run selection. The exact command and path list remain in that log and evidence.

`python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p release_candidate_tests.py` passed15 tests90.115s with the actual CLI full candidate and selected failure/recovery paths. Coordination tests passed12 in1.612s for the author. Shell syntax, Python compile, docs/releases/README.md prose enforcement (0 errors/warnings), readability (18 advisories), diff and scoped record checks passed. The real built candidate is reused as exact input for the composed negative cases; they do not rebuild or substitute validator successes.


The reviewer independently ran `PYTHONPATH=scripts python -m unittest release_coordination_tests`:12 tests passed2.674s at /tmp/release-m3-review-r2-unit.log. That exercises actual CLI confidential filesystem-error handling, parsed current workflow, missing setup/credentials/recovery and exact/conflicting mirror behavior. The reported complete integration was inspected case-by-case; the recorded upstream candidate full verification remains real, not a fixture-generated pass. Earlier failed confidentiality/selector/proof runs retain their original failed results and disclosed fixes. Local selected CI does not claim a hosted run, configured protection or a successful real public release.

## Finding dispositions

- release-m3-f1: Resolved: actual CLI main classifies low-level filesystem/process/malformed-input errors into bounded operator messages, preserves only controlled release-domain messages with private diagnostic suffix removed, and safely handles a failed summary write. Actual-main regression confirms private worker path absent from stderr and summary.

- release-m3-f2: Resolved: real candidate preparation/check/package chain now enters actual argparse/environment/output main; the same verified retained candidate drives complete external-only lost-response, failed actual packed CLI smoke, failed Git persistence and restored-attempt recovery scenarios. Assertions preserve single approval, original bytes, previous incomplete events and exactly one public write per confirmed boundary. No authorization, correctness-validator or Git persistence success stub replaces these boundaries.

- release-m3-f3: Resolved: coordinator archives the exact version-scoped durable Git commit and mirrors it best effort. Provider checks an existing named mirror for exact bytes and refuses conflict rather than clobbering. Optional unavailability is durably distinguished from required completion; mirror-report persistence failure retains incomplete recovery observations. Snapshot commit/digest is explicit and does not mutate approved candidate bytes or require recursive self-inclusion.

## CI maintenance reassessment

Review operation only; GitHub Actions privileged-approved-design, CIM7 with coverage inspection. The unchanged reviewed YAML has a read-only prepare job followed by one protected execute job with only required write/OIDC permissions, exact SHA checkouts, no credential persistence or tag bypass, immutable candidate uploads and always-on attempted-operation observation retention. Source/selector paths choose the existing affected validation owners; corrections add no new workflow or external configuration. Current selected CI is evidence only for its exact local command composition. Hosted CI observation: not-observed. Mutation outcome: none. No additional CI-maintenance design/change is required before continuing M4; final applicable PR/Verify checks remain separately required.

## Checklist

| Item | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec alignment | pass | M3 TG-05/06 and REL identity, authority, proof/reporting/confidentiality obligations satisfied within fixture scope. |
| Test coverage | pass | Actual CLI and real candidate complete path, plus selected failure/recovery and mirror cases. |
| Edge cases | pass | Duplicate/lost response, failed public smoke/reporting, restored immutable observations, absent timing/mirror and conflict cases covered. |
| Error handling | pass | Bounded diagnostics and summary failure; incomplete results and observation-first recovery preserved. |
| Architecture boundaries | pass | Thin coordinator consumes existing candidate/executor/validator owners; optional mirror uses exact durable basis. |
| Compatibility | pass | Explicit new evidence ref and historical reader split; no legacy publication bypass or historical rewrite. |
| Security/privacy | pass | Single protected path, immutable byte binding, OIDC/credential gate and sanitized CLI errors. |
| Derived artifact currency | pass | Real producer/package chain and exact durable snapshot mirror; diagnostic limitations visible. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | Bounded M3 code/CI/docs/proof changes only; M4 removal unimplemented. |
| Validation evidence | pass | Current author selected command evidence and independent focused tests, with no unsupported hosted claim. |

## Handoff

M3 can close under this independent milestone review; route may continue authorized M4. Original findings were resolved by their reporter after changed-implementation reassessment, preserving old judgment subjects. This does not replace final independent whole-change Code Review or distinct Verify, and does not establish PR or release readiness.
independence_basis: Original independent reporter authored no engineering and freshly reassessed complete M3 corrections/CI interactions, actual proof and exact subjects.
